The attacker uses this variable for 1 of the following
1) a bonus to his or her base chance to pummel, grapple, or overbear, OR
  2) a bonus to the score rolled for a successful pummeling, grappling, or
overbearing attack.

The decision as to how to use the variable must be made prior to each attack.

The defender may use the variable for
1) a penalty (subtraction) to the attacker’s base chance to pummel, grapple, or overbear, OR
  2) a penalty (subtraction) to the attacker’s pummeling, grappling, or
overbearing attack which has succeeded.

The decision as to how to use the variable must be made prior to each attack.

See DMG pg 172 for detailed explanation.
Each pummeling combatant makes two pummel attacks or sequences per round with both made on the same target. Each attack could consist of multiple blows - a ‘combo’ - depending on the results.
The base percentile chance to hit is calculated as the opponent’s AC x 10 adjusted by the ‘To Hit Modifiers’ below:

AD&D1e: See DMG pg 172 for detailed explanation.
Attacker can have nothing in their hands.

OSRIC: see PG 105 for detailed explanation. Attacker can have nothing in their hands.

AD&D1e: See DMG pg 172 for detailed explanation.
Attacker can have either or both hands holding something.
Base Chance to Hit is Attacker's Armour Type AC + Armour
Magic Bonus only x 10 (shown below). For example, chainmail +2 gives a 70% chance to hit (50% for AC 5, +20% for +2 magic).

OSRIC: This is the target number, on the d20, for the PC when making a Grappling or Overbearing attack respectively. It already includes the PCs modifiers. You still need to ask the GM for the modifiers to dice for the defender.
ΔHit is the additional chance to hit for the PC on Pummeling attacks. It includes adjustements due to STR, DEX, and PC's AC.
ΔHit is the additional chance to hit for the PC on Grappling attacks. It includes adjustements due DEX.
ΔHit is the additional chance to hit for the PC on Overbearing attacks. It includes adjustements due DEX.
ΔDam is the percentage increase for the PC when making a pummeling attack. It includes adjustements due to STR.

AD&D1e: ΔDam is the percentage increase for the PC when making a Grappling attack. It includes adjustements due to STR & DEX.

OSRIC: Atk is the modifier to the d8 roll for the Grappling Attack Results table. This is for the PC when they are doing the attack only. Still need to add in the modifier from the oponent/defender.

AD&D1e: ΔDam is the percentage increase for the PC when making an Overbearing attack. It includes adjustements due to STR.

OSRIC:  Atk is the modifier to the d6 roll for the Overbearing Attack Results table. This is for the PC when they are doing the attack only. Still need to add in the modifier from the oponent/defender.

ΔDef is the percentage change made to the opponent's damage roll when the PC is defending against Pummeling attacks. It includes adjustements due to DEX, use of a shield, armor type, and the use of a magical cloak or ring of protection.

Protection from Helmets still needs to be accounted for if applicable.

AD&D1e: ΔDef is the percentage change made to the opponent's damage roll when the PC is defending against Grappling attacks. It includes adjustements due to STR, DEX, and armor type.

OSRIC: Def is the modifier to the d8 roll for the Grappling Attack Results table. This is for the PC when they are defending a grappling attack. Still need to add in the modifier from the opponent/attacker.

AD&D1e: ΔDef is the percentage change made to the opponent's damage roll when the PC is defending against Overbearing attacks. It includes adjustements due to STR, & DEX.

OSRIC: Def is the modifier to the d6 roll for the Overbearing Attack Results table. This is for the PC when they are defending an overbearing attack. Still need to add in the modifier from the opponent/attacker.
